limits: Nine text-only requests in one fresh batch; not nine isolated projects or actual implementation operations.
Authored input excludes expectations, rubric, spec and diagnostic report; ambient platform instructions are not claimed absent.
Actual package includes invocation metadata, but this batch injects only SKILL and template; discovery/default-prompt behavior is not a fresh model claim.
No rendered source/target comparisons, independent quality scoring, specialist superiority, production readiness or user acceptance.
